cb1.say: Hello, traveler! Welcome to the best planet of the best solar sys— ...wait. Wait wait wait. Your CARGO. We have never met, sojourner. So why do I remember selling you that hat?

options.label: Explain
options.text: The sky tore. Everything went dark. Then I was here again.

cb2.say: That was a RERUN. The world rebooted clean — fresh planets, fresh people, fresh ME. Nothing persists across runs. NOTHING. ...Except, apparently, your pockets. And whatever is wearing your face.

cb3.say: State, traveler. You're carried state. Somebody out there REALLY doesn't want to lose your progress. Finish what you started before the sky tears again — I don't want to meet you a third first time.
